bio.text: Dick Durbin, a Democrat from Springfield, is the senior U.S. Senator from Illinois; he was elected on November 5, 1996, and re-elected in 2002, 2008, 2014 and 2020.
He has been elected Senate Democratic Whip by his colleagues every two years since 2005.
He is married to Loretta Schaefer Durbin and they reside in Springfield.
